name: ramp-retarget-midflight
description: A new ramped target arrives while the previous ramp is still in flight. This is the only trace that exercises `ramp_start_value = self.get_value_at(timestamp)` in V2ChannelState::set_target with a partially-completed ramp — a port that re-anchors from `current_value` or from the previous target instead of from the interpolated position produces a visible discontinuity here and nowhere else. A: 0 -> 1.0 over 800ms, retargeted to 0.3 over 400ms at +600ms (mid-ramp), then to 0.9 over 600ms. B: the same pattern with an inverse curve and shorter ramps.
